Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That’s it from the coverage of this game. So, the White Ferns move to the second spot in the points table while India Women are pushed down to the fifth spot and this loss has also affected their NRR a lot. The ICC Women’s World Cup will continue on 11th March. It is a game which sees a contest between Pakistan Women and South Africa Women. The first ball is at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Till then take care and goodbye!

Sophie Devine, New Zealand Women skipper, is in for a chat. She says it was a complete performance, Kerr and Amy were brilliant, they felt they were short but the bowlers were outstanding. Mentions it is their strength, different people perform when needed. Adds Tahuhu was brilliant, she set the tone and Frances Mackay was also really good and with the options they have, they can be flexible. Ends by saying the first game they played was a great game of cricket, they did not play near their best but they were really good today and looking forward to the next game.

Mithali Raj, the India Women skipper, is in for a chat. She says the bowlers did well to pull things back, they were looking at 270 but they did well to restrict them to a low score. Adds they lost quite a few wickets earlier on and they needed someone to play through. Mentions the hosts' seamers were bowling well but they could have done better. Ends by saying the top middle-order needs to fire, the bowlers have done well but the batting needs to do better.

Amy Satterthwaite wins the Man of the Match award for her exception effort with blade. She says, it was an interesting wicket to bat on. She just tried to apply herself and made the most of it. Adds the bowlers were outstanding in the opening 20 overs and did well to put India under pressure straightaway.
Stay tuned for presentation.

For India, it was a poor batting display. They just lacked intent and were quite defensive. That just built the pressure and when they tried the big shot, it did not come off. Kaur was the only one who put up a fight, she fought a lone battle but it was too much of a task for her. Quite disappointing, the whole performance from the Indians.

A superb display with the ball by the hosts! We felt they were a few under-par at the end of the first innings but they have defended the runs quite easily. They were extremely disciplined, built the pressure and got wickets courtesy the pressure that was built. Jess Kerr was brilliant with the new ball. Lea Tahuhu was at her best. Hannah Rowea did go for a few but the others were so good, that it covered up for them. Tahuhu was probably the pick along with Amelia Kerr. Both got three. Hayley Jensen picked a couple to end the Indian innings.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Two in two for Hayley Jensen and that is the end of the game! New Zealand Women WIN BY 62 RUNS! This is a length ball outside off, Rajeshwari Gayakwad looks to defend but this goes off the outside edge and it is taken by Katey Martin behind the sticks. A comprehensive win for the hosts.
Commentary.Howout: c Katey Martin b Hayley Jensen

Commentary.Commentary: Rajeshwari Gayakwad is the last batter in.
OUT! TOP NUT! A yorker right on the leg pole. Jhulan Goswami looks to jam it out but misses and is cleaned up. New Zealand now only a wicket away.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! Fuller and on middle, this is clubbed down the ground for a boundary.
Fuller, on off. Singh pushes it to cover for a single.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Back of a length, on off. Meghna Singh works it down to third man for a boundary.
Floated, full and on off. Jhulan Goswami tries to sweep it away. The ball flies off the top edge towards mid-wicket. The fielder gets under it but spills the catch in the end.
Flatter and outside off. Jhulan Goswami tries to play it late but misses.
SIX! BANG! An overpitched delivery, on off. Jhulan Goswami clears her front leg and tonks it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.

Edgy! Full-length delivery, on off. Meghna Singh tries to flick it away to the leg side. Although, the ball takes the outside edge and goes fine on the off side. Lea Tahuhu does well to stop the ball in the deep. They take two.
Fuller, on the stumps. Singh makes a little room and drives it towards cover.
Full length, outside off. Singh tries to drive it away but fails to get any bat on the ball.
Slower one, on a length, swinging away. Singh leaves it alone.
Full length, on off. Jhulan Goswami pushes it to cover for one.
Swing and a miss! A short ball, outside off. Jhulan Goswami tries to cut it away but misses.
Meghna Singh is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Amelia Kerr picks up her third wicket and this should be the final nail in the coffin. Harmanpreet Kaur valiant knock comes to an end. Fuller, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to hunt for the biggie. She goes hard after it but ends up lofting it to long off. Sophie Devine takes the simplest of catches.
Commentary.Howout: c Sophie Devine b Amelia Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant by Amelia Kerr. Tossed up, full and outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to dig it out but misses.
Fuller, on off. Jhulan Goswami hits it to long on for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur shuffles across gets underneath it and lofts it towards long off. It meets Sophie Devine on a bounce. They take one.
Full toss, on off. Jhulan Goswami eases it to long off for one.
FOUR! Well, well, well. Jhulan Goswami gets into the act as well. Fuller, on off. Jhulan Goswami throws her blade at it and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
FOUR! 20 from the over! 90 needed in 42. Something to cheer about now for the Indian fans. Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through backward square leg for a boundary.
SIX! Into the crowd again! That is a meaty blow! On middle, Kaur shuffles across and heaves it over the mid-wicket fence.
Two dots now! Shorter and outside off, Kaur looks to cut but misses.
She will be disappointed she did not find the gap! Outside off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! In the gap! 10 from the first two balls. On middle, this is heaved again, it goes through mid-wicket, in the gap and to the fence.
SIX! They need it to rain boundaries now! On middle, the slog sweep comes out. It sails over the mid-wicket fence.
Fuller, on off. Jhulan Goswami drives it to cover.
Looped up, on off. Jhulan Goswami defends it out.
FIFTY for Harmanpreet Kaur. She would now certainly look to take the attack to New Zealand Women. Fuller, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it down to long off for a single.
Full and on off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets low and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Tossed up, on off. Jhulan Goswami pushes it to cover for one.
Length, on off. Jhulan Goswami defend it out solidly.
FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur moves to 47. Back of a length, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it through mid-wicket for boundary.
Swing and a miss! Short ball, outside off. Kaur looks to chase it but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hannah Rowe send back Pooja Vastrakar on a low score. This was bound to happen. India Women slip further. Back of a length, on off. Pooja Vastrakar comes down the track and looks to heave it away across the line. The ball takes the top-edge and flies towards mid off. Sophie Devine moves to her right and grabs the ball safely. Jhulan Goswami is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Sophie Devine b Hannah Rowe

Commentary.Commentary: Another single! Fuller, on middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur works it to mid on for one.
Full length, on the pads. Pooja Vastrakar flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length, on off. Kaur hooks it to deep square leg but only gets a single as Maddy Green slides to her left to keep it down to one.
Tossed up on off, Kaur looks to sweep, it goes off the top edge towards short fine leg for one.
On middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one more.
Shorter and on off, Pooja Vastrakar slams it back towards the bowler, she is unable to stop it but it hits the stumps behind.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On off, defended.
On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off, Pooja slashes but misses.
FOUR! That is a welcome boundary! India need a lot more! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to her right and dives but fails to stop it.
Pooja Vastrakar comes down the track and then drives it towards cover foir one.
On middle, Kaur works it through mid-wicket for one.
This time she gets it past the fielder at mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on middle, Pooja Vastrakar pulls it but to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Outside off, left alone.
On middle, defended.
Pooja Vastrakar comes in at number 8.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and Lea Tahuhu has another one! A nasty delivery. Short and angling into the body. Sneh Rana initially looks to sway out of the way but then looks to guide it down to third man. It goes off the glove and Katey Martin makes no mistake behind the stumps.
Commentary.Howout: c Katey Martin b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one more.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
A dot to end! On off, defended.
On middle, Rana nudges it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Just the one again as this is pushed to long off.
Just the one! Singles are not enough! Rana steps out and eases it down to long on for one.
Two dots in a row now! Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point.
On middle, Rana works it to short fine leg.
Frances Mackay (6-1-14-0) is back into the attack now.
Confusion but safe! On middle, Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it to mid on. Rana takes off but is sent back. Sophie Devine misses her throw. Run rate needed now above 9. India need boundaries.
That stays a touch low! On middle, Kaur gets her bat down in time and defends.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side, wided.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Fuller and shaping away from the off pole. Rana looks to drive but is beaten/.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On off, Rana pushes it to mid off.
Good delivery! The leg spinner, it lands on off and then turns away. Rana is beaten as she tries to block.
Shorter and on the pads, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Tossed up on off, Rana guides it to point.
Three to begin the over! On middle, Kaur plays the paddle sweep nice and fine. Three taken.
On off, this is cut to point. Sneh Rana misses out.
Shorter and outside off, Rana slashes but misses.
Overthrow and one! On off, this is pushed towards cover. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The fielder backing up does not do her job. A single.
A single now as this is guided down to third man for one.
Well done by Katey Martin! A full toss on the pads, this is worked fine, the keeper dives to her left and saves a boundary.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
EDGY FOUR! Tossed up around off, this lands and then turns away. Rana looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence for a boundary.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Nicely played! Flatter and on off, Rana hangs back and plays it down to third man for two.
On middle, Kaur works it through square leg for one.
Fuller and on off, this is hit through covers for one.
On middle, defended.

DRINKS! India Women have five wicket in hand and need to chase down 158 runs in 114 balls now. The task isn't impossible but India really need a solid stand to get them closer to the finish line. New Zealand Women have never let the Indian batters score freely. Their bowlers have been at the top of their game and would hope to end things quickly before India can hurt them.
Top edge but safe! Shorter and on middle, Rana pulls, it goes off the top edge towards fine leg for one.
A short one, on the body, Rana looks to pull but misses. A good sharp bumper.
Fuller and on middle, Rana strokes it to mid on.
Another one on the fuller side and on off, Rana strokes it to mid off.
Fuller and on off, Rana pushes it to covers.
Drop and run! On off, this is pushed toward cover for one.

FOUR! A boundary on the hat-trick ball! Sneh Rana connects with the cut shot. The length was shorter than what it was against Richa Ghosh. Rana rocks back and cuts it through point to get off the mark in style. 100 up for India. 160 more needed.
Sneh Rana is the new batter in. 5 fielders close in for a catch, we do not see that in an ODI game but the Kiwis can afford that at the moment. Will Amelia Kerr get her hat-trick?

OUT! Two in two for Amelia Kerr and Richa Ghosh walks back for a golden duck! They needed Richa Ghosh to play a cameo here, they needed her to score some quick fire runs but she just misreads the length. The googly, it is slightly fuller and it lands outside off. Richa Ghosh looks to cut by going back, this one spins back in, sneaks under the bat and hits the off pole. The game just seems out of sight now for India. A Harmanpreet Kaur special will be needed if they are to have a chance.

OUT! STUMPED! What is this shot by Mithali Raj? She goes back in an ugly way. It is fuller and outside off. Mithali Raj comes down the track and tries to whip it across the line but misses. Katey Martin gathers the ball and is very quick to take the bails off. Mithali Raj is gutted by this effort. She shakes her head and trudges back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: st Katey Martin b Amelia Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on off, Raj blocks it out solidly.
Fuller, outside off. Kaur gets low and sweeps it through mid-wicket for one.
LEG BYE! A googly this time, on off. Raj shuffles across and tries to flick it away but misses. She gets hit on her pads. The batters take a leg bye.
Fuller, on off. Kaur pushes it to cover.
Short ball, outside off. Raj pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, on off. Raj pushes it to cover. The fielder scores a direct hit and the keeper puts in an appeal. The replays show Raj was in and there is no danger.
Back of a length, on off. Raj pulls it hard but straight to the fielder.
Touch short, on off. Kaur pulls it to square leg for one more.
Fuller, on off. Raj works it to long on for a single.
FOUR! This time Hannah Rowe cannot stop it in the deep. Floated, full and on off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Length, on middle and leg. Raj glances it to fine leg for a single.
On the stumps, blocked out.
Kaur sweeps it again to deep square leg but for one this time.
Brilliant work by Hannah Rowe in the deep. Tossed up, full and outside off. Kaur gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Hannah Rowe dives to her right and saves a certain boundary. They take two.
Fuller, on off. Raj gets low and sweeps it through mid-wicket for one.
Looped up, around middle and leg. Raj clips it to fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Raj sweeps it to square leg.
Fuller, on the stumps. Kaur pushes it to long off for a single.
Looped up, outside off. Raj guides it to third man for one.
A single now! Flighted, full and on off. Kaur comes down the track and eases it to mid on for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Kaur pushes it to cover with soft hands.
Flatter and on the pads, Raj stays back and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Harmanpreet Kaur now gets on one knee and sweeps this full delivery to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Looped up, down leg. Raj gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg for another single.
Angled into the pads. Kaur goes back and pushes it to mid on.
Tossed up, around off, blocked out watchfully by Kaur.
Fuller, on off. Raj drives it to cover for one.
A length ball, on off. Kaur defends it out solidly. 9 runs off the over for India Women. This is the over they needed desperately.

FOUR! Much-needed boundary for India Women. A short ball, on middle and leg, Harmanpreet Kaur swivels on the back foot and pulls it through square leg. This time she pierces the two fielders in the deep and finds the ropes.
Raj now drives a full-length delivery to sweeper cover. They take a single.
A short ball, outside off. Raj stands tall and cuts it hard to deep point. The batters push hard for two and get two. Good intent shown here.
On a length, outside off. Kaur punches it through covers for one run. Now, this Indian pair is making sure to keep the runs ticking.
Length ball, on the pads. Raj clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, on off. Kaur defends it out. 5 runs off this over. New Zealand bowlers are keeping things very tight and simple.
Back of a length, on the bodyline. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it to deep square leg. The fielders in the deep work in tandem to keep it down to two.
Length delivery, around off. Kaur gets behind the line and blocks it out.
Full length, on the pads. Raj flicks it to mid-wicket for another single.
Length, on middle and leg. Kaur stays inside the crease, clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full length, outside off. Mithali Raj prods and drives it through the cover region for one. This really won't hurt New Zealand Women.
Good-length delivery, on the stumps. Kaur defends it to cover off the outer half. Just a single off the over. India Women need to get some boundaries now.
Two dots in a row now! Kaur offers full face of the blade to this length ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Length, on off. Kaur defends it out watchfully.
Length ball, on off. Raj guides it to backward point for a single.
Full length, outside off. Raj drives it to cover on the front foot.
Full length, outside off. Mithali Raj pushes it to cover.
A length ball, outside off. Raj throws her blade at it. The ball goes towards third man off the outside edge. One taken.
Full length, on off. Kaur drives it through covers for one.
Length, on off, blocked out.
CLOSE! An off-pace delivery. Full and around off. Mithali Raj drives it aerially towards cover but it lands just in front of the fielder there. They take one.
A length ball, outside off, nips in a touch. Mithali Raj prods and pushes it to cover.
Full length, outside off. Mithali Raj taps it to the off side.
Short ball, outside off. Mithali Raj hangs back and cuts it square on the off side for a single.
SWING AND MISS! A length ball, outside off. Mithali Raj looks to cuts it away but misses.
Length, on off, blocked out solidly.

FOUR! Streaky! Just flies past Frances Mackay at first slip. But India won't mind how the runs come at this moment. A full-length ball, outside off. Mithali Raj looks to drive it away, it flies off the outside edge, past the slip flelder and into the fence at third man.
A full-length ball, on off. Mithali Raj gets under it and lofts it over mid on. It clears Sophie Devine with ease and the batters take two runs.
Length ball, around off. Mithali Raj defends it to cover.
Yet another length ball on off, Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it to covers.
On off, Kaur plays it to mid off.
On off, Kaur guides it to point.
Another one on a length and on off, blocked.
Good length and on off, defended.
Harmanpreet Kaur is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Yastika Bhatia now has to walk back! India now in deeper trouble! Lea Tahuhu is having a ball with the ball out there. She had Raj dropped in the last over in the cover region but this time gets Yastika Bhatia caught in that same region. A slower one on off, this one holds in the surface too. Yastika Bhatia is early in the stroke. She ends up chipping it to covers where Frances Mackay makes no mistake this time. 211 more needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Frances Mackay b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: Yet another one on a length, this is pushed to covers.
A short one on middle, Yastika Bhatia pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, this is guided through point for one.
The dots are racking up! India need to get going. On off, Raj blocks again.
Yet another one on a length and around off, defended.
Fuller and angled into the pads, Yastika Bhatia looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.

DROPPED! That was not the easiest of chances but it has been put down! A slower one, holds in the surface a touch. Raj plays a check-drive, it goes uppishly to the right of the cover fielder. Frances Mackay moves to that direction, sticks on hand up but the ball does not stick.
Bangs it short again, this is guided down to third man for one.
Fuller and on off, Yastika Bhatia pushes it to mid off.
A bumper again, Yastika Bhatia evades it.
Bangs this one in short and outside off, Yastika Bhatia looks to play the upper cut but is beaten.
BEATEN AGAIN! Fuller and outside off, Yastika Bhatia looks to stroke it through covers but misses.
Another run! On off, this is eased through covers for a run.
On off, Raj strokes it through covers for a single.
Length and on off, Raj pushes it to covers again.
That is a loose stroke! Fuller and outside off, Mithali Raj looks to push at it away from the body. She gets beaten.
Angled into the pads, Yastika Bhatia looks to flick but misses. She gets hit on the pads. Half an appeal but turned down. It rolls on the off side. A leg bye taken.
Good length and on middle, Yastika Bhatia pushes it to mid on.

DRINKS! New Zealand Women clearly hold the upper hand in this game. They have started brilliant with the ball and have hardly let the Indian batters to free their arms. India Women need their current pair to do a solid repair work and build a solid foundation for the remaining batters. New Zealand Women know if they keepy applying the same pressure they can easily get over the line here while Mithali Raj holds the key for India in this chase.
On off, Raj plays it to cover.
Short and outside off, Raj leaves it alone.
Just the one again! Outside off, Yastika Bhatia strokes it through covers for one more.
Good length and on off, Yastika Bhatia blocks.
Outside off, on a length, this is guided doown to third man for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Top edge but safe! Shorter and on middle, Yastika Bhatia looks to pull, fails to get on top of the bounce, it goes off the top edge but lands safe in the square leg region. One taken.
WIDE! This is way too short now, Yastika Bhatia ducks under it.
Angled into the pads, Raj works it through square leg for one.
Shorter and on off, Yastika Bhatia guides it down to third man and takes one.
Carcked but to the fielder! Shorter and on middle, Yastika Bhatia pulls but to mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, Yastika Bhatia looks to play the upper cut but misses.
FOUR! Up and over! India will hope this breaks the shackles. Lovely stroke too. This is full and on off, Yastika Bhatia lofts it over mid off and this races away to the fence.
A short one to end, it is evaded. Lea Tahuhu continues to keep it tight. Just the 3 runs from her 3 overs.
Another one on a length and around off, Raj defends.
This is fuller and on off, Yastika Bhatia strokes it through covers for one.
BEATEN! That was there to be hit! Full and outside off, Yastika Bhatia looks to drive but is beaten.
Fuller and on middle, Bhatia jams it out to covers.
Length and on off, Bhatia pushes it to covers.
A single to end! Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
An effort ball from Rowe! Short and outside off, Bhatia leaves it alone. The keeper takes it above her head. Signaled one for the over.
Fuller and on middle, Bhatia works it to mid on.
Three and Raj is off the mark! Fuller and outside off, Raj drives it through covers. It is a long chase for the fielder. The ball slows up as it gets to the ropes. Three taken in the end.
Fuller and on off, Raj pushes it to mid off.

Finally a run for India! Fuller and on off, this is hit wide of mid off for one. Yastika Bhatia is struggling a little, she was seen limping as he went at the other end. She has also signaled to the dressing room about something.
Make that two maidens in a row! Shorter and outside off, Raj cuts but to point.
Outside off, Raj leaves it alone.
BEATEN! Good movement. Length and on off, this one shapes away. Raj looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
Make that 10! Length and on off, Raj pushes it to covers.
Make that 9 dots in a row now! Outside off, Raj guides it to point.
Yet another dot! Length and outside off, left alone.
A maiden then by Rowe. A sort one to end, Bhatia ducks under it.
Make that 5 dots in a row! On off, Bhatia strokes it to covers.
Slightly fuller and on off, Yastika Bhatia pushes it to mid off.
Confusion but no harm done! Shorter and on off, Bhatia guides it towards point. Raj this time wants one but Bhatia is ball watching.
Drags the length back and bowls it on a length and on off, defended.
Confusion but safe! Fuller and on off, Bhatia strokes it wide of cover and wants one but is sent back. There was probably a single there. Raj was slow off the box.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Review time! A huge appeal for an LBW is turned down. That swung in a long way, it is hitting but where is the impact? Seems outside off. Maybe umpire's call.

OUT! LBW! What a ripper of a delivery by Lea Tahuhu to end her first over. She also send back Deepti Sharma on a timid score. A length ball, pitching just outside off but comes in sharply. Deepti Sharma stays inside the crease and tries to flick it away but misses it completely. She gets pinged on her pads. Lea Tahuhu appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Lea Tahuhu is certain she got the better of the batter this time and convinces her skipper to take a review. Sophie Devine goes with the bowler and takes a review. The UltraEdge confirms no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking later shows three reds and Deepti Sharma trudges back to the pavilion.
WIDE! Full length, sliding down leg. Sharma misses her flick. Wide called.
Fourth dot of the over! Yorker, right on the money. Sharma digs it out to the leg side.
Full length, outside off. Sharma taps it to point.
Fuller, outside off. Yastika Bhatia lofts it over backward point for a single.
Full-length delivery, angled in on off. Yastika Bhatia defends it back to the bowler.
A length ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia defends it to cover.
Change! Lea Tahuhu is on now!
Very full, on off. Sharma drives it down the ground. The fielder from mid off moves to her left to stop the ball.
FOUR! Top shot! A length ball, angling down leg. Deepti Sharma stays back and glances it down to fine leg. Boundary.
SAFE! Back of a length, on off. Yastika Bhatia goes for the pull shot. The ball takes the top-edge and evades the effort of the slip fielderto lands safely at third man. One taken.
A length ball, on off. Yastika Bhatia gets it off the inside edge.
A length ball, on off. Yastika Bhatia works it towards point. The fielder dives to her left and makes a half-stop.
Full length, on off. Yastika Bhatia drives it to cover.
Full length, on middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia stays back and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Length, on the stumps. Bhatia defends it out.

FOUR! Glorious shot! Yastika Bhatia finds the gap on consecutive deliveries now but this time the result is much better. Full length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia leans in and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Finally, Yastika Bhatia gets it through the gap! A length ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia comes down the track and drives it past mid off. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it towards point but cannot get it through.
WIDE! Full length, angling down leg. Yastika Bhatia comes down the track but misses her flick. Wide called by the umpire.
Length ball, outside off, shaping away. Yastika Bhatia punches it to cover.
Full, outside off. Deepti Sharma gets low and slaps it to mid off. A maiden for Frances Mackay now, she has been brilliant with her line and lengths.
The dot balls keep creeping up. Full, on the stumps. Deepti Sharma defends it to cover.
Flatter and short, around off. Sharma punches it to cover.
Full, on middle and leg. Deepti Sharma flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on the stumps. Sharma prods and blocks it out.
Full, on leg. Sharma defends it to the leg side.
On a length, outside off. Deepti Sharma guides it towards third man for a single.
Length ball, on off, pushed to cover.
Deepti Sharma is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jess Kerr draws the first blood. Jess Kerr comes 'round the wicket and serves a full-length ball, on off. The dots balls got the better of Smriti Mandhana. She tries to clear the in-field with a lofted shot but ends up chipping it straight to Suzie Bates who makes no mistake. New Zealand Women have got the early wicket that they were after.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Jess Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover.
Full length, on off, pushed to cover.
Full length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana comes down the track and drives it crisply towards cover. Straight to the fielder yet again. The opening pair is finding it difficult to penetrate the gap.
CHANCE! Just short though! Tossed up, full, on middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia lifts it towards mid on. The fielder there run forward but could not pouch the ball safely. The batters take two.
Short and on the fourth stump line. Yastika Bhatia cuts it to point but finds the fielder.
Full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
Flighted, full, on off. Mandhana works it to the right of the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans in and drives it into cover. She could not beats the fielders placed there. Jess Kerr with a maiden over now.
Unable to get it through the gap. Another length ball is pushed to cover.
Short ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to cut it away but gets it to hit the deck hard off the inside edge.
Third dot on the trot! This will surely build some pressure. Length ball, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover.
Full length, on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to cover.
Back of a length, on off, close to the body. Smriti Mandhana does not get much width on offer and hence punches it to cover with soft hands. She could not hit it with power.
Touch short, around off. Yastika Bhatia stays back and punches it to cover. Another tidy over by Frances Mackay, only 1 run comes off it.
Overpitched, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans in and works it through mid off for a single.
Short and outside off. Mandhana shuffles across and cuts it to point.
Fuller, on off. Mandhana defends it to cover off the front foot.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana steps down and eases it back to the bowler.
Looped up, full and on off. Mandhana drives it back to the bowler.
Three dots on the trot by Jess Kerr to end the over. Back of a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it to point but straight to the fielder.
A length ball, pitching around leg and shaping across the left-hander. Yastika Bhatia stays back and clips it to the leg side.
Second dot in the over! Full length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia opens the face of the blade and drives it to cover.
Back of a length, on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it through mid-wicket for one. The fielder does really well to cut it out quickly.
Length, on off, blocked out solidly.
Slightly short, outside off. Smriti Mandhana stands tall and punches it through cover-point for a brace.
Jess Kerr to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Overpitched, outside off. Bhatia drives it to cover on the up but is unable to find the gap. Just 2 runs off the first over.
Tossed up, full and on off. Yastika Bhatia works it towards mid on.
Touch short, outside off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it to covers. The fielder fumbles and the batters take a single. Smriti Mandhana is off the mark as well.
On the pads, Yastika Bhatia flicks it to mid-wicket for a quick single. India Women and Yastika Bhatia are off the mark.
Flighted, fuller, on middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia comes down the track and clips it to mid-wicket.
Touch short, on off. Yastika Bhatia stands tall and punches it to point. Not in the gap though.
